3879701.bio: Quicksand are a New York post-hardcore band formed in 1990, known for Slip (1993) and Manic Compression (1995). They paired heavy riffs with melodic songwriting, and returned with Interiors (2017) and Distant Populations (2021).
3879701.name: Quicksand

3881491.bio: Instrumental post-rock band from Beverly, Massachusetts, with a cinematic sound built on lush guitars, keyboards and powerful drumming. Known for albums such as The Four Trees and On Circles (2020).
3881491.name: Caspian

3887256.bio: Chaz Bundick, South Carolina-born chillwave pioneer who moved through 80s R&B, house and funk. Causers of This (2010), Anything in Return and What For? are notable records.
3887256.name: Toro Y Moi

3887879.bio: Funky Juice Records-affiliated studio project playing Latin dance-floor jazz, mixing Cuban mambo and salsa with disco, jazz-funk and club beats. Releases include Mambostar (2005) and Cuban Disco Connection (2011).
3887879.name: Cuban Jazz Combo

3895791.bio: New York duo Madeline Follin and Brian Oblivion, whose gauzy, twinkling indie pop draws on girl-group sounds and dark undertones. Their self-titled 2011 debut spawned Go Outside; later records include Static (2013) and To the Ghosts (2024).
3895791.name: Cults

3906124.bio: Folkgaze band featuring Emma Ruth Rundle with Dave Clifford, Julian Rifkin and Paris Patt. Blended folk, shoegaze, chamber pop and post-rock on the 2011 album Aokigahara.
3906124.name: The Nocturnes
3906124.note: Location is a guess from Emma Ruth Rundle's base; not confirmed.

3909697.bio: Duo of Molly Hamilton and Robert Earl Thomas combining hazy dream pop, country twang and jangly indie pop. Their sound was foggiest on the 2011 debut Widowspeak, with later albums Plum (2020) and The Jacket (2022).
3909697.name: Widowspeak

3915703.bio: Los Angeles singer-songwriter who emerged as a teenager in synth pop before turning to darker alt-pop and rock. Night Time, My Time (2013) is her acclaimed debut.
3915703.name: Sky Ferreira

3918337.bio: Stuck in the Sound are a French indie rock quartet from Paris, influenced by Nirvana, the Pixies and Sonic Youth. Albums include Nevermind the Telephone (2006), Pursue the White Whale (2012) and Survivor (2016).
3918337.name: Stuck in the Sound

3919170.bio: London-based indie pop quintet with Northern English roots and an American member, playing warm dreamy guitar pop with boy-girl vocals. Wild Notion (2018) and Fortune Teller (2019) are their records.
3919170.name: Night Flowers

3922893.bio: Singer-songwriter from St. Louis, later Asheville, known for a vibrato-tinged voice rooted in old country and folk. She moved from sparse acoustic work on Strange Cacti to fuller indie rock on Burn Your Fire for No Witness and orchestral drama on All Mirrors and Big Time.
3922893.name: Angel Olsen

3923125.bio: San Francisco psychedelic duo of guitarist Ripley Johnson (Wooden Shjips) and keyboardist Sanae Yamada, with chilly electronic underpinnings and drones inspired by Spacemen 3 and Suicide. Albums include Mazes (2012), Occult Architecture (2015) and Stars Are the Light (2019).
3923125.name: Moon Duo

3923467.bio: Project of English singer-songwriter and producer Emily Underhill, offering atmospheric, introspective indie electronica. Debut Dissolve came on One Little Indian; later releases include Avalanche (2019) and Gold (2024).
3923467.name: Tusks

3923470.bio: Alaska-born, Portland-based band mixing neo-psychedelic indie rock with dance, R&B, hip-hop and electronics. Global hit "Feel It Still" came from Woodstock (2017); recent records include Chris Black Changed My Life (2023).
3923470.name: Portugal. The Man

3927452.bio: Heavy, melodic trio from Dallas, Texas, formed in 2007 by Dan Phillips, Nicole Estill and Timothy Starks. Slow, hypnotic songs on Circumambulation (2011), Circumambulation (2013) and AVVOLGERE (2016) blend shoegaze, slowcore and stoner doom.
3927452.name: True Widow

3929921.bio: Bosnian band from Sarajevo formed in 2003, known for energetic mixes of ska, punk, hip hop, balkan folk and electronics, with politically satirical lyrics in English and Bosnian. Albums include Wild Wild East (2013) and Agrikultura (2022). They are a popular festival act across Europe.
3929921.name: Dubioza Kolektiv
3929921.note: No Tidal bio; based on general knowledge, not verified by search

3931868.bio: Irish instrumental rock band formed in 2002, combining epic post-rock melodies with electronics and an anti-war stance. All Is Violent, All Is Bright (2005) is a standout; Embers (2024) is recent.
3931868.name: God is an Astronaut

3935353.bio: Ringo Deathstarr are an Austin, Texas band combining noisy indie pop, shoegaze and dream pop in the spirit of Ride and My Bloody Valentine. Key records include Colour Trip (2011) and Mauve (2012).
3935353.name: Ringo Deathstarr

3938220.bio: San Francisco band who blend black metal with shoegaze and post-rock and reject being pinned to either label. Sunbather (2013) was a landmark, followed by New Bermuda, Infinite Granite (2021) and Lonely People With Power (2025).
3938220.name: Deafheaven

3941031.bio: The Daysleepers are a shoegaze band from Buffalo, New York, formed in 2004. Their sound recalls Slowdive and the Cure. Key records include Drowned in a Sea of Sound (2008) and Creation (2018).
3941031.name: the daysleepers

3941035.bio: Chicago dream pop group active since the late 1990s, building lush walls of effects-laden guitar and yearning vocals. Their sound draws on British shoegaze such as Ride and Kitchens of Distinction. Molten Young Lovers (2017) is a key release.
3941035.name: airiel

3947529.bio: Alternative rock quartet from Blackpool, England, inspired by Sigur Ros, This Will Destroy You and Caspian. They combine ambient post-rock textures with heavier alt-rock moments on albums like Ceremonia and Mountains.
3947529.name: Blanket

39497113.bio: flyingfish is Sam Fishman, a shoegaze musician from Phoenix, Arizona. His instrumental "wonder if u care" (2023), made with MIDI guitars in FL Studio, went viral on TikTok. EPs include Isolation (2023) and The Way Night Falls.
39497113.name: flyingfish

3951258.bio: Bristol trio led by Portishead's Geoff Barrow, drawing on krautrock, dub and the Beach Boys. Their self-titled 2009 debut set a gloomy, motorik template followed on albums like >>> (2018) and >>>> (2024).
3951258.name: Beak>

3961153.bio: New Zealand songwriter and producer making woozy, disorienting psychedelic pop inspired by soft rock and smooth jazz. Known for Forever Dolphin Love, Caramel and the Jassbusters albums (2018, 2021), and as a collaborator with other artists.
3961153.name: Connan Mockasin

3964001.bio: Prog rock band formed in Hamburg, Germany by four Englishmen in the late 1960s, creating spacey, psychedelic progressive music. Remember the Future (1973) is a classic; the band was still active with Psykonaut (2026).
3964001.name: Nektar

3970053.bio: Stage name of Natalie Mering, who moved from experimental origins to lush, haunted chamber pop. Titanic Rising (2019) and And in the Darkness, Hearts Aglow (2022) are her best-known records.
3970053.name: Weyes Blood

3979909.bio: Project led by Ruban Nielson, born in New Zealand and based in Portland, Oregon, blending psychedelic pop, lo-fi funk and soul. Albums include the 2011 debut, II (2013), Multi-Love (2015), Sex & Food (2018) and FEAR (2026).
3979909.name: Unknown Mortal Orchestra

39819357.bio: Las Vegas trio fusing Korean and English lyrics with 80s-flavored goth and post-punk, which they call k-goth or Seoulwave. Their Die Cry Hate EP came out in 2023.
39819357.name: past self

39867403.bio: South Korea-linked shoegaze and neo-psychedelic artist whose EP Your Embraces Were Warm (2023) alternates big shoegaze tracks with quiet acoustic folk pop; songs have Korean titles.
39867403.name: May Lily
39867403.note: Origin inferred from Korean song titles; unconfirmed

3997333.bio: American singer-songwriter and former Odd Future associate whose work defies R&B categories with introspective lyrics and experimental production. Defined by channel ORANGE (2012) and Blonde (2016).
3997333.name: Frank Ocean

4000027.bio: Jamie Smith, producer and member of The xx, whose solo work blends dance, indie and R&B with sample-rich beatmaking. In Colour (2015) was a landmark, and In Waves (2024) continued his club-oriented sound.
4000027.name: Jamie xx

40131861.bio: Singer-songwriter project based in Athens, Georgia, mixing Americana-flavoured folk, wistful indie pop and an alt-rock edge in a style she calls bootgaze. Debut album Finer Things came out in September 2025, with Virginia Slim as first single. Porch Lights (2024) preceded it.
40131861.name: Clover County

4014212.bio: London dream pop duo of Tessa Murray and Greg Hughes, with delicate vocals and cinematic, otherworldly atmospheres. Their debut Creatures of an Hour (2011) evoked Morricone, with later albums Slow Air (2018), The Last Exit (2021) and Dream Talk (2024).
4014212.name: Still Corners

40261756.bio: Los Angeles singer-songwriter Izzy Hagerup, making dark-textured indie rock that veers between post-punk and ragged experimentation. Releases include System (2025) and Through the Window (2026).
40261756.name: Prewn

4063663.bio: British electronic duo of Chris Davids and Liam Ivory, producing warm, emotive music that draws on house, garage and indie rock with pitch-shifted vocals. Albums include Portraits (2015), Kingdoms in Colour (2018), Fallen Universe (2022) and Hallucinating Love (2025).
4063663.name: Maribou State

4064719.bio: Tokyo instrumental quartet often labeled post-rock or math rock, with Mino Takaaki, Yamazaki Hirokazu, Kashikura Takashi and Yamane Satoshi. Albums include The Book About My Idle Plot (2005), Hear You (2009) and NOW I SEE THE LIGHT (2024).
4064719.name: toe

4068070.bio: Los Angeles bassist and singer Stephen Bruner, a go-to bassist for forward-looking artists across the 2000s. His nimble, groove-heavy basslines and sweet tenor span jazz and R&B on Drunk (2017) and It Is What It Is (2020).
4068070.name: Thundercat

4087094.bio: Canadian electronic pop duo of Corin Roddick and Megan James from Edmonton, mixing glitchy, bass-heavy production with ethereal vocals. Debut Shrines (2012) was followed by Another Eternity (2015), WOMB (2020) and graves (2022).
4087094.name: Purity Ring

4096554.bio: Liverpool-born multi-instrumentalist and producer who started as guitarist in The Coral at 15 before going solo. His acclaimed records include Yawn (2018), Yawny Yawn (2019) and Iechyd Da (2024), mixing orchestral arrangements with intimate songwriting.
4096554.name: Bill Ryder-Jones

4099011.bio: Whirr is a California shoegaze band who mix 90s dreamy sonics with louder guitars and heavier drums. Key records include Pipe Dreams (2012), Sekret (2014) and Feels Like You (2019).
4099011.name: Whirr

4099308.bio: American singer-songwriter who built a cinematic, melancholic Californian-Americana persona. Born to Die (2012) made her a star; later records include Norman F***ing Rockwell! (2019) and Did You Know That There's a Tunnel Under Ocean Blvd (2023).
4099308.name: Lana Del Rey

4109671.bio: Anonymous French collective of musicians and artists associated with the symbol 'unequal', mixing spoken-word vocals with indie rock and electronic backing. Their debut Vieux Freres (2013-15) became a hit in France, followed by Blizzard (2015) and Deep into Nature (2021).
4109671.name: Fauve

4112974.bio: American singer-songwriter from California with a dramatic soprano and dark imagery. She moved from haunting folk on Apokalypsis (2011) and Unknown Rooms (2012) toward doom, industrial and gothic rock, with The Dark released in 2026.
4112974.name: Chelsea Wolfe

4113912.bio: London shoegaze-inspired band built around Gothenburg-born Suzanne Aztoria and guitarist Jimmy Lee. Reverb-drenched, deadpan dream pop heard on Ester (2012) and Althaea (2017).
4113912.name: Trailer Trash Tracys

4114224.bio: Four-piece post-rock band from Norrköping, Sweden, formed in 2004 as Before You Give In. Their cinematic, guitar-driven instrumental music appears on Versus (2016) and Oscillate (2021).
4114224.name: pg.lost

4115593.bio: Mackenzie Scott's solo project, based in Brooklyn and active since 2013. Known for introspective, intense indie rock and records such as Sprinter (2015), Thirstier (2021) and What an enormous room (2024).
4115593.name: TORRES

4133324.bio: Sister duo Hannah and Colette Thurlow from London, named after a drum roll in a Melvins song. They make sparse, moody lo-fi garage and post-punk-tinged pop; their self-titled debut came in 2012, followed by The Other I in 2014.

4143898.bio: Seba Jun, a Japanese producer from Tokyo who defined jazz-infused hip hop, best known for Metaphorical Music (2003), Modal Soul (2005) and the Samurai Champloo soundtrack work. He died in a 2010 car accident.
4143898.name: Nujabes
4143898.note: No Tidal bio; bio from general knowledge.

4167706.bio: New York band led by Teeny Lieberson mixing psychedelic rock and 90s R&B into experimental pop. Early albums include In Limbo (2012) and Love Yes (2014); recent is NEW CLASSIC (2026).
4167706.name: TEEN

4192314.bio: Man Without Country is the project of Welsh musician Ryan James, formed in 2007 with Thomas Greenhalf, who left in 2016. Their blend of dream pop, synth-pop and shoegaze appears on Foreign Land (2012) and Infinity Mirror (2018).
4192314.name: Man Without Country

4198739.bio: Indie rock band founded in 1989 by David Berman with Stephen Malkmus and Bob Nastanovich. Mixed lo-fi, country-rock and witty, profound lyrics. American Water (1998) and Tanglewood Numbers (2005) are standouts; ended after Lookout Mountain, Lookout Sea (2008).
4198739.name: Silver Jews

4202618.bio: Los Angeles duo of Shaun Durkan and Bre Morell on Ghostly International, making maximalist dream pop with 90s radio hooks, breakbeats and distortion. Releases include Extra Life (2024) and no scope (2025).
4202618.name: Crushed

4203238.bio: Multi-instrumentalist specialising in guitar-driven dance music, who cuts his own vinyl records. Releases include Art Life (2023) and Sun Lifter (2024).
4203238.name: richard houghten
4203238.note: Little-known artist; bio from Tidal text and hints only

4206414.bio: Texas shoegaze band blending the heavy side of the genre with Deftones, Slowdive and Drop Nineteens influences. Built an online following with early singles and the 2021 EP Heavenly before debut Sunset Funeral (2025).
4206414.name: Glare

4207785.bio: Long-running shoegaze and dream pop group from Tallinn, Estonia, mixing walls of guitar noise with sweet harmonies and autumnal electronics. Albums include Empty Parks (2020), Now You Know It Still Feels the Same (2022) and Evening Colours (2023).
4207785.name: Pia Fraus

4207804.bio: Dream-pop and space-rock band from Northeast Florida formed from the ruins of Starbelly, with Susan Hanson on guitar. Releases include the 2025 album Au revoir; fans of Slowdive and Tears Run Rings.
4207804.name: Stella Luna
4207804.note: Active years approximate; Tidal bio used.

4208773.bio: Los Angeles alternative R&B band that began as an Odd Future spin-off and grew into a distinct act centered on Syd and Matt Martians. Albums include Purple Naked Ladies (2011), Ego Death (2015) and Hive Mind (2018).
4208773.name: The Internet

4261568.bio: Five-piece from Leeds, Yorkshire, known for a visceral live urgency and blown-out psychedelic indie across the LPs Pearl Mystic (2013) and The Hum (2014). Later they turned toward cleaner synth textures on Microshift (2018).
4261568.name: Hookworms

4274204.bio: Post-punk band from Rostov-on-Don, Russia, known for melodic, jangly guitars and cold, deadpan vocals in the tradition of Joy Division and The Cure. Albums include Alps (2010), Poem (2012) and Dialogues (2016).
4274204.name: Motorama
4274204.note: Tidal bio missing; bio from general knowledge and hints

4279326.bio: American dream pop duo of vocalist Melissa Arpin and guitarist Scott Cortez, formed in the early 1990s in Texas. Their swirling guitar textures are heard on records such as Bloweyelashwish (1999) and glissceule (2002).
4279326.name: Lovesliescrushing

4298868.bio: Portland, Oregon post-punk band fronted by Tobias Sinclair, defining 2010s darkwave-leaning post-punk. From raw beginnings on An Open Door (2011) toward anthemic heights, they draw on the Chameleons and the Sound.
4298868.name: Soft Kill

4301467.bio: Solo psychedelic pop project of Jay Watson, also drummer in Pond and Tame Impala. Debut Delorean Highway (2014) began a varied run that includes Blue Gum Way (2026).
4301467.name: GUM

4301985.bio: New Zealand-born singer-songwriter who gained global attention on Gotye's Somebody That I Used to Know (2011). Her adventurous pop draws on jazz, R&B and rock; albums include Vows (2011), The Golden Echo (2014) and Primal Heart (2018).
4301985.name: Kimbra

4304602.bio: German post-rock and math rock band formed in 2001 by Jan Heinemann, Florian Koller, Matthias Horn and Martin Eichhorn. They released Wasserluft (2003), a 2005 follow-up and The Goal Is to Make the Animals Happy (2007), their latest, with vocals. Compared to El Ten Eleven and Explosions in the Sky.
4304602.name: SDNMT

4315444.bio: Harlem rapper and A$AP Mob co-founder who broke out in 2011 with his mixtape Live.Love.A$AP. Blends Southern-influenced cloud rap with high-fashion swagger; key records include Long.Live.A$AP (2013) and Testing (2018).
4315444.name: A$AP Rocky

4319451.bio: Swedish post-rock band founded in 2009 in Kristinehamn, now the duo of brothers Jakob Hemström and Oskar Nilsson, adding trumpet, cello and trombone to cinematic, intense guitar music. Albums include Myriad (2022), All Things Shining (2024) and And the Dead Tree Gives No Shelter (2026).
4319451.name: Oh Hiroshima

4323947.bio: Instrumental math-rock trio led by guitarist Yvette Young, noted for her two-handed finger-tapping style and intricate song structures. They formed in the Bay Area and released the EP Currents (2015) and albums effloresce (2020) and technicolor (2020).
4323947.name: Covet

43450342.bio: American shoegaze artist behind If Not Winter (2025), her debut album on Interscope, who has become a face of the mid-2020s shoegaze revival. Sound blends dreamy guitars, electronics and pop hooks.
43450342.name: Wisp

4348856.bio: London soul singer-songwriter whose 2012 debut Home Again blended folk and soul. Love and Hate (2016) and Kiwanuka (2019) deepened his cinematic, psychedelic soul, and Small Changes arrived in 2024.
4348856.name: Michael Kiwanuka

4351582.bio: Brighton duo of bass and drums channeling blues rock with scuzzy riffs and volume. Their Mercury-nominated debut (2014) was followed by How Did We Get So Dark?, Typhoons and Back to the Water Below (2023).
4351582.name: Royal Blood

4352.bio: Influential German electronic group formed in West Berlin by Edgar Froese in 1967. Pioneers of Berlin School electronic music and soundtracks, with albums like Phaedra (1974) and Rubycon (1975).
4352.name: Tangerine Dream

4353178.bio: Tidal entry appears to be a Spanish-language audiobook or spoken-word recording of Goethe's novel Werther, not a musical act. Little further detail could be determined.
4353178.name: J.W. Goethe
4353178.note: Not a musical artist: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe (author) credited on an abridged Werther recording (2007).

4363249.bio: Omar Banos, a Mexican-American singer-songwriter from Hawthorne, California, who rose from SoundCloud with hazy, romantic bedroom pop and psychedelic Latin touches. Known for Wannabewithu and Para Mi, with Ridin' released in 2025.
4363249.name: Cuco
4363249.note: Bio from general knowledge and hints; no Tidal bio

4370776.bio: Swiss band from Baden, formed in 2009, working in alternative, krautrock-tinged and psychedelic territory. They release in series such as Temporar Musik (2016, 2024) and the album Acedia (2019).
4370776.name: One Sentence. Supervisor

4374117.bio: Sydney post-rock band that formed in 2006 around guitarist Jonathan Khor. They combine cinematic guitars and electronics in instrumental builds. Albums include Love of Cartography (2014) and Great Dismal Swamp (2017).
4374117.name: sleepmakeswaves

4399011.bio: Norwegian psychedelic trio drawing on krautrock and jazz-rock. Their releases include Diversions Vol. 2: Enter the Astral Plane (2023) and Langt, langt vekk (2024).
4399011.name: Kanaan

4446045.bio: Australian psychedelic pop band from Sydney, started as a teenage home-recording project by Nic McKenzie and Nick Weaver. Debut Outlands came out in 2012, followed by Blacklight in 2018; Weaver left in 2018 and died in 2021.
4446045.name: Deep Sea Arcade

44497948.bio: fc.kleinstadt describes itself as a shoegaze and post-punk quartet from a small town. German-language releases include the tracks "höhenangst" and "normal". Little further detail is available.
44497948.name: fc.kleinstadt
44497948.note: Origin inferred from German-language profile; little information found

4472557.bio: German psychedelic folk-rock band formed in 2006 in Hohenlimburg, named after the NYC club where Nico first played in America. Their dark, melancholic sound was shaped by Velvet Underground; albums include Narcotica (with Anton Newcombe) and A Sea of Trees (2014).
4472557.name: The Blue Angel Lounge

4474853.bio: Do-it-yourself indie band from Philadelphia with Jane handling visuals and Ian producing. Records include Awestruck (2019), One Stop Shop (2022) and Fate Euphoric (2025).
4474853.name: Twen

4491197.bio: Leeds-formed art-rock band who met at university and broke through with the Mercury Prize-winning An Awesome Wave (2012). Their sound mixes folk, electronics and angular indie rock; This Is All Yours (2014) and The Dream (2022) followed.
4491197.name: alt-J

4496618.bio: Canadian songwriter known for his off-kilter, laid-back charm and woozy, chorus-drenched guitar pop. Albums include 2 (2012), Salad Days (2014) and Here Comes the Cowboy (2019).
4496618.name: Mac DeMarco

4533984.bio: Sithu Aye is a Scottish-Burmese guitarist and producer based in Scotland who writes, records and produces everything himself. His 2011 debut Cassini includes Double Helix; later releases include Homebound (2018) and Senpai III (2021).
4533984.name: Sithu Aye

4546495.bio: Deep Sea Diver is the project of Jessica Dobson, a Californian-born singer-songwriter based in Seattle who previously played with The Shins and Beck. Their indie rock has an arty post-punk edge. Albums include Secrets (2014), Impossible Weight (2020) and Billboard Heart (2025).
4546495.name: Deep Sea Diver

4583321.bio: Little-known act on Tidal whose releases include On The Inside (2015) and I Won't Waste This (2019). Could not be reliably identified.
4583321.name: Wildflowers
4583321.note: Could not identify artist; generic name, bio based on hints only

4608042.bio: London power trio that blended technical, progressive heaviness with big pop hooks and a strong live reputation. Formed in 2006 around Andrew Groves, with records like Blood & Chemistry (2013) and Melancholia Hymns (2017).
4608042.name: Arcane Roots

4611746.bio: Oxford band led by Dave Bayley, blending synth pop, indie, R&B and hip hop. ZABA (2014) introduced their surreal, rippling sound and Dreamland (2020) produced the global hit Heat Waves. Latest: I Love You So F***ing Much (2024).
4611746.name: Glass Animals

4612849.bio: Los Angeles indie pop group blending 60s bubblegum, vintage soul and hip hop into a hypnotic sound, with sample-heavy singles and EPs. French Exit (2021) and Grapes Upon the Vine (2023) are among their records.
4612849.name: TV Girl

46260617.bio: Swiss reggaeton duo (Biceps and Moictani) drawing on Lake Geneva, the Atlantic and the Valais mountains, singing in Spanish and French with feminist, playful lyrics. Releases include the singles Malalaise and Gaga (2024).
46260617.name: Tendinites

4643209.bio: Neo-shoegaze band formed in Hackney, London in 2012 and rapidly buzzing through online singles. Albums are Comfort (2013) and Waiting a Lifetime (2017).
4643209.name: Splashh

4646142.bio: Brooklyn band led by Zachary Cole Smith, joining shoegaze bliss to grunge catharsis. Debut Oshin (2012) showed Nirvana, My Bloody Valentine and Malian guitar influences; later records include Is the Is Are (2016), Deceiver (2019) and Frog in Boiling Water (2024).
4646142.name: DIIV

4653420.bio: Idles are a Bristol band formed in 2009, mixing punk fury with a muscular, moody attack and literate, purposeful lyrics. Key records include Brutalism (2017), Joy as an Act of Resistance (2018) and Ultra Mono (2020).
4653420.name: IDLES

46736661.bio: Sol Cordoba, a singer-songwriter and composer from Cali, Colombia, part of the Vallecaucano singer-songwriter scene with an indie Andean style. Her debut single Fragmentos de una tarde en Pance came in 2025, and its video won a local award.
46736661.name: Sol Menguante

4696787.bio: Project of French musician Melody Prochet, crafting swirling psych-pop with prog and folk touches. Works include the Kevin Parker-produced debut (2012), Bon Voyage (2018) and Emotional Eternal (2022).
4696787.name: Melody's Echo Chamber

47119025.bio: Alternative act whose single There's a Reason You're Alone (2024) was written by Vinciento Hong. Little else is known.
47119025.name: Vincemp3

4748331.bio: Spanish artist from Barcelona who bridges flamenco tradition and global pop. El Mal Querer (2018) and MOTOMAMI (2022) established her as innovative, and LUX arrived in 2025.
4748331.name: ROSALÍA

4751080.bio: Seattle-based musician Peter Michel, who makes dazed, melodic dream pop reflecting his experience with dissociation. Signed to Barsuk after the Dunes EP, he released albums such as Halve (2019), Éclo (2022) and It Seems to Me (2025).
4751080.name: Hibou

4754843.bio: Zurich noise-leaning trio of David Schönenberger, Manuel Clausen and Michael Cerezo, mixing shoegaze, indie rock and synth-driven textures. Records include Technique Magique (2013/14, Ikarus Records) and Davvinci Code (2018).
4754843.name: Davv

4764745.bio: Glasgow synth-pop trio of Lauren Mayberry, Iain Cook and Martin Doherty, pairing indie roots with big, chart-friendly synth hooks. Debut The Bones of What You Believe (2013) was followed by records including Screen Violence (2021).
4764745.name: CHVRCHES

4770172.bio: Birmingham band playing guitar rock with 80s dream pop and 90s shoegaze influences. Debut Where the Heaven Are We (2013) was followed by Mothers, Emerald Classic and Hum (2026).
4770172.name: Swim Deep

4778717.bio: Shriduna is a Zurich, Switzerland band that began as a solo project in 2010, inspired by the deep sea and whale sounds. Releases include Fish in a Balloon (2013) and Quasar (2014).
4778717.name: Shriduna

4808934.bio: Manchester guitarist and co-songwriter of The Smiths who shaped 1980s indie rock, later playing in Electronic, The The, Modest Mouse and The Cribs. His solo albums include The Messenger (2013), Playland (2014) and The Age of Everything (2026).
4808934.name: Johnny Marr

4811562.bio: Melbourne band led by singer Nai Palm, mixing R&B, jazz and hip-hop with intricate, progressive flair. Known for Choose Your Weapon (2015), Mood Valiant (2021) and Love Heart Cheat Code (2024).
4811562.name: Hiatus Kaiyote

4828104.bio: Maruja are a Manchester quartet whose debut album Pain to Power came out in September 2025 on Music for Nations. The lead single Look Down on Us is a ten-minute politically charged outpouring of heavy, jazz-tinged rock.
4828104.name: Maruja

4830250.bio: Roberto Carlos Lange, Ecuadorian-American musician from Florida (now New York), making ambient pop that honors his Latin heritage. Early albums like Awe Owe (2009) merged folk, jazz, electronic and Latin elements; later records include Far In (2021) and Phasor (2024).
4830250.name: Helado Negro

48361880.bio: Alternative rock band from Cali, Colombia, fusing Colombian folk with indie rock. Their first full-length Sueños Ultravioleta portrays the awkward passage from adolescence to adulthood and led to a tour of Colombia and Ecuador.
48361880.name: Vinilo Pintao'
48361880.note: No Tidal bio; active years uncertain.

4844164.bio: Haitian-Canadian producer from Montreal, mixing Dilla-inspired hip hop beats with woozy house. His XL debut 99.9% won the 2016 Polaris Prize; later albums include Bubba (2019) and Timeless (2024).
4844164.name: KAYTRANADA

4848663.bio: Rostam Batmanglij, Iranian-American producer and multi-instrumentalist, formerly of Vampire Weekend. Solo debut Half-Light (2017) is kaleidoscopic pop; he has produced for Haim, Clairo and others.
4848663.name: Rostam

4852314.bio: Los Angeles indie rock band led by Clementine Creevy, mixing 90s grunge, fuzzy alt-pop and dark lyrics. Albums include Apocalipstick (2017), Stuffed & Ready (2019) and I Don't Want You Anymore (2023).
4852314.name: Cherry Glazerr

4869311.bio: Katie Crutchfield, Alabama-born songwriter, started with self-recorded lo-fi material and moved into folk-rock and country. Albums include American Weekend, Out in the Storm, Saint Cloud and Tigers Blood (2024).
4869311.name: Waxahatchee

4891573.bio: Swiss band known for driving rhythms, careful songwriting and the ethereal voice of Mario Hänni. Albums include Episodes (2019), The Course of Events (2021) and Lightning Sulfur Calm (2024), the last with guest vocals by Evelinn Trouble.
4891573.name: Mnevis
4891573.note: Start year and city not verified

4895106.bio: Detroit post-punk quartet led by lyricist Joe Casey, delivering burly yet intelligent music with free-associative poetry. Albums include Ultimate Success Today (2020), Formal Growth in the Desert (2023) and Hotel Usona (2026).
4895106.name: Protomartyr

4903321.bio: American singer and rapper of Mexican descent who moves between pop and rap in English and Spanish. Broke out with "Shower" in 2014 and has since scored regional Mexican and reggaeton-leaning hits, with albums such as ENCUENTROS (2024).
4903321.name: Becky G

4906194.bio: Brazilian pop star from Rio de Janeiro who became one of Latin music's biggest global names. She mixes funk carioca, reggaeton and dance-pop on records such as Versions of Me and Funk Generation.
4906194.name: Anitta

4909607.bio: Experimental indie group formed by ex-members of slowcore band Duster, led by Jason Albertini with a rotating lineup. Recent albums include The Beach at the Edge of the World (2023) and Gladness III (2026).
4909607.name: Helvetia

4910538.bio: Queens rapper and former chef known for gravelly, Ghostface-like delivery and food-obsessed, absurdist lyrics. Rose through mixtapes and major releases in the early 2010s, with records like Mr. Wonderful and Cocodrillo Turbo.
4910538.name: Action Bronson

4914449.bio: Screamo and math rock trio from Benson, Minnesota, formed around Dylan Mattheisen and the Chevalier brothers. Albums include Pleasant Living (2013) and Swell (2016).
4914449.name: Tiny Moving Parts

4915442.bio: North London rock band formed in 2010 around Ellie Rowsell, Joff Oddie, Theo Ellis and Joel Amey, moving between grunge, shoegaze and dream pop. Albums include My Love Is Cool (2015), Visions of a Life (2017, Mercury Prize), Blue Weekend (2021) and The Clearing (2025).
4915442.name: Wolf Alice

49246712.bio: Dark Chisme is a Seattle duo of Chicago-raised DJ and vocalist Christine Gutiérrez and multi-instrumentalist Erik Schneider. Their self-titled 2024 debut mixes darkwave, EBM, post-punk, techno and goth with Latin flavor, including the single "Yo Puedo Vivir Sin Ti".
49246712.name: Dark Chisme

4927007.bio: English neo-psychedelic band from Kettering, mixing trippy retro touches with classic pop craftsmanship. Albums include Sun Structures (2014), Volcano (2017) and Hot Motion (2019).
4927007.name: Temples

4932381.bio: London R&B singer-songwriter of Irish and Jamaican heritage, drawing on contemporary R&B, pop and dance music and known for collaborations with dance producers. Releases include Lessons in Love (2019) and Boundaries (2024).
4932381.name: Sinéad Harnett

4936299.bio: London-based singer, pianist and poet born in Edmonton, raised in a non-musical household and largely self-taught; he busked in Paris before success. His theatrical, piano-driven soul and art-song won the 2015 Mercury Prize for At Least for Now, followed by I Tell a Fly (2017).
4936299.name: Benjamin Clementine

4949602.bio: London post-punk band with gothic undertones and a dark, dreamy but aggressive sound. Their records include Desperate Journalist (2015), Grow Up (2017) and No Hero (2024).
4949602.name: Desperate Journalist

4959537.bio: Mr. Ray appears to be a children's music act, whose releases include the anti-bullying album No Room for Bullies (2015) and the Norwegian-titled Over Grensen (2017). Little verified detail was found.
4959537.name: mr. RAY
4959537.note: Little information found; may not match the fan's intended artist

4971631.bio: Nicolas Herzig, a Swiss-Colombian musician and co-founder of rap crew LDDC. He started solo in 2013 with Mi Vida Es Mía (2014), moving between Spanish-language hip hop and romantic reggaeton-pop, notably with the 2017 single Sin Ti.
4971631.name: Loco Escrito

4989012.bio: Paris-based producer and multi-instrumentalist Vincent Fenton (French Kiwi Juice). His mellow tracks combine live looping with jazz, soul and electronic touches. Known for the self-titled debut (2017) and V I N C E N T (2022).
4989012.name: FKJ

5000626.bio: Dreamy instrumental project of Chicago crate-digger Dante Carfagna, who emerged with mysterious early singles. The sound blends warm electronic textures and hazy samples across Fixed Rope (2015) and Fixed Rope II (2018).
5000626.name: Express Rising

5004869.bio: Marcel Everett, young Florida producer who emerged on SoundCloud in 2011. His self-titled debut XXYYXX (2012) blends lo-fi dark ambient, cloud rap and electronic textures.
5004869.name: XXYYXX
5004869.note: No Tidal bio; based on own knowledge, not web-verified

5017065.bio: London shoegaze and indie electronic project led by former Curve guitarist Dean Garcia and his daughter Rose Berlin, with various guests. Releases include The Art of Pop (2015) and Fifteen (2019).
5017065.name: SPC ECO

5020362.bio: Australian singer-songwriter Ry Cuming, based in Los Angeles, known for airy, spiritual and nature-driven music, and co-founder of the duo Howling. Albums include Dawn (2014), Unfurl (2018) and Blood Moon (2022).
5020362.name: RY X

5054713.bio: Colombian reggaeton and urbano star from Medellin who became a Latin pop crossover force with hits like "Mi Gente". Albums include La Familia (2012), Vibras (2018) and Oasis (2019, with Bad Bunny).
5054713.name: J Balvin

5086494.bio: Melbourne singer-songwriter known for deadpan, conversational lyrics and loose guitar rock. She emerged in 2012 with an EP and made her name with Sometimes I Sit and Think, and Sometimes I Just Sit (2015), followed by Tell Me How You Really Feel (2018).
5086494.name: Courtney Barnett

5086918.bio: Tess Parks is a Canadian psych-pop singer-songwriter who signed to Alan McGee's 359 Music. Her smoky voice and lo-fi sound appear in collaborations with Anton Newcombe, including I Declare Nothing (2018).
5086918.name: Tess Parks

5107654.bio: Pennsylvania act combining Slowdive and My Bloody Valentine-era shoegaze with plaintive electro-ambient indie pop. Releases include Cosmic Tidal Wave (2022) and Love Pedals (2025).
5107654.name: The Stargazer Lilies

5135134.bio: English trio from Nottingham with cinematic electronic pop built around Hannah Reid's powerful vocals. Debut If You Wait (2013) was followed by Truth Is a Beautiful Thing and The Greatest Love (2024).
5135134.name: London Grammar

5142.bio: English band from Portsmouth centred on the childlike, haunting vocals of Alison Shaw. Their sound is hard to categorise, drifting from gothic dream pop to electronic textures, with albums such as Wings of Joy (1991) and Loved (1994).
5142.name: cranes

5142460.bio: Melbourne band formed in 2011, mixing Ride-style loud guitars with Slowdive-like dream pop melodies. Albums include Fantasy Country (2021) and You Never Know (2023).
5142460.name: Flyying Colours

5151716.bio: Filipino singer, songwriter and multi-instrumentalist Idris Vicuna making woozy lo-fi music across warped R&B, synth pop and indie. Records include Vampire in Beverly Hills (2024) and Stoner (2025).
5151716.name: Eyedress

5153608.bio: Colombian singer-songwriter Elsa Carvajal, born in Bucaramanga in 1993 and a Berklee alumna, who performs as Elsa y Elmar. She makes uplifting Latin pop and rock, with recent releases including Palacio (2024) and ciclos (2026).
5153608.name: Elsa Y Elmar

5177798.bio: Houston trio inspired by Thai funk and 60s-70s rock, plus surf, dub and Iranian pop, creating smooth, groove-heavy instrumentals. Albums include The Universe Smiles Upon You (2015), Con Todo El Mundo (2018) and A LA SALA (2024).
5177798.name: Khruangbin

5184716.bio: Boston-area indie rock band led by Sadie Dupuis, with gnarled guitars and literate lyrics in the spirit of 1990s indie. Starting with lo-fi The Death of Speedy Ortiz (2011), later albums include Twerp Verse (2018) and Rabbit Rabbit (2023).
5184716.name: Speedy Ortiz

5188920.bio: Singer-songwriter born in Texas, based in Kansas City, with Dylan-esque lyricism and rootsy production, formerly of Woods and The Babies. Notable records include Singing Saw (2016), City Music and Oh My God.
5188920.name: Kevin Morby

5205780.bio: Cloakroom are an Indiana band who call their sound stoner emo, mixing hardcore weight, shoegaze haze and sad 90s indie rock. Albums include Further Out (2015), Time Well (2017) and Dissolution Wave (2022).
5205780.name: Cloakroom

5225054.bio: Connecticut band whose Dinosaur Jr.-style overloaded guitars meet Built to Spill songcraft, led by Steve Hartlett. Launched with EPs in 2009 and 2011; albums include Am (2013), TRU (2018) and Buds (2021).
5225054.name: Ovlov

5237820.bio: Colombian reggaeton and Latin pop star from Medellin, whose polished mix of reggaeton, pop and R&B made her one of Latin music's biggest names. Key albums include KG0516 (2021), Mañana Será Bonito (2023) and Tropicoqueta (2025).
5237820.name: KAROL G

5238762.bio: Bilderbuch are an Austrian band from Kremsmünster, active since the mid-2000s. Their theatrical sound mixes indie rock, pop, funk, disco and hip hop, sung in German. Albums include Schick Schock (2015), Magic Life (2016) and Gelb ist das Feld (2022).
5238762.name: Bilderbuch

5293333.bio: Venezuelan-born, London-based producer, singer and visual artist Alejandra Ghersi. Her work is boundary-pushing, mixing deconstructed club music, reggaeton and avant-garde electronics. Key records include Arca (2017) and the Kick series (2020-2021).
5293333.name: Arca

5336235.bio: Prolific, restlessly experimental Australian band from Melbourne, formed in 2010, releasing multiple albums per year across garage, psych, thrash, microtonal and jazz-rock. Key records include Nonagon Infinity (2016), Fishing for Fishies (2019) and Phantom Island (2025).
5336235.name: King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard

5360105.bio: Giraffes? Giraffes! is a duo from New York City formed in the early 2000s, playing abrasive, technical math rock with noisy and metal edges and joke-laden titles. Releases include Superbass!!!! (2015), Memory Lame (2018) and Death Breath (2022).
5360105.name: Giraffes? Giraffes!

5401144.bio: Mexican alternative pop-rock band from Mexico City, formed around 2010. Their emotive, melodic Spanish-language songs have earned a large following in Latin America, with tracks like Miénteme and No Confíes en Mí. Recent releases include MAPAS and Jardín de las Almas.
5401144.name: Camilo Séptimo
5401144.note: No Tidal bio; origin and dates from general knowledge, not verified by search

5401978.bio: Connecticut duo of Dan Barrett and Tim Macuga whose self-released debut Deathconsciousness (2008) became an internet cult hit. Their sound mixes droning shoegaze, industrial and gloomy post-punk; later releases include The Unnatural World (2014) and Sea of Worry (2019).
5401978.name: Have A Nice Life

5406485.bio: Dark, sultry shoegaze band formed in 2007 by Aimee Nash and Scott Von Ryper after leaving the Morning After Girls. Originally from Sydney, collaborated with members of Brian Jonestown Massacre and Black Rebel Motorcycle Club. Albums: Buy the Ticket, Take the Ride (2009) and The Door Behind the Door (2015).
5406485.name: The Black Ryder

5408370.bio: Instrumental band formed in San Diego in 2008, mixing math rock, jazz fusion and technical guitar with sunny, laid-back grooves. Known for Grow (2015) and the self-titled Chon (2019).
5408370.name: Chon

5416271.bio: St. Louis-born R&B singer-songwriter on Top Dawg Entertainment with a vulnerable, poetic style. Albums include Ctrl (2017) and SOS (2022).
5416271.name: SZA

5438769.bio: Seattle electronic duo producing dreamy indie electronica that stretches to festival-scale anthems. Albums include In Return (2014), A Moment Apart (2017) and The Last Goodbye (2022).
5438769.name: ODESZA

5458962.bio: Australian indie band from Perth, essentially the project of Jake Webb, mixing breezy dream pop and psych-rock between Tame Impala and Syd Barrett-era Pink Floyd. Records include Are You Haunted? (2022).
5458962.name: Methyl Ethel

5467779.bio: Los Angeles rapper and singer who turned viral buzz into pop stardom with R&B-flecked, genre-hopping songs. Hot Pink (2019) and Planet Her (2021) made her a global star, followed by Vie (2025).
5467779.name: Doja Cat

5487487.bio: British electronic producer Jake Lee, formerly in deathcore bands, who makes atmospheric dark electronic music blending witch house, darksynth and goth influences. Albums include Future Ghosts (2014), White Light (2015) and Exorcism (2022).
5487487.name: Sidewalks and Skeletons

55.bio: American trumpeter and bandleader whose career spanned five decades and nearly every major jazz shift. Landmarks include Kind of Blue (1959), Bitches Brew (1970) and the cool jazz sessions of the 1950s.
55.name: Miles Davis

5518561.bio: Peruvian singer-songwriter born in 1967 in Cusco, associated with Andean music, who recorded in Santiago, Chile. Best known for Vienes y te vas and Niñachay; recent releases include PASSERELLE (2026).
5518561.name: William Luna
5518561.note: No Tidal bio; active start approximate.

55225.bio: Norwegian singer-songwriter Aurora Aksnes who combines frosty electronic textures, spare beats and clear, emotive vocals in a dark pop style. Her debut All My Demons Greeting Me as a Friend came in 2016. Runaway and Into the Unknown (from Frozen 2) are among her best-known songs.
55225.name: AURORA

5528489.bio: Synth-pop act on [PIAS] Belgium, known for the single Lotion (2017) and the Colorate EP (2018), which also includes Tych and Know Where. Details on the members were not found.
5528489.name: Dead Sea
5528489.note: Origin unclear; label is PIAS Belgium. Not confirmed the same act as other 'Dead Sea' artists.

5542024.bio: Baltimore indie quintet formed in 2011, led by Lauren Shusterich. Textured shoegaze and noise pop with '60s girl-group and '80s post-punk touches.
5542024.name: Wildhoney

5546899.bio: Tokyo psychedelic rock band mixing krautrock, Indian raga and acid folk. Breakthrough House in the Tall Grass (2016) was followed by Masana Temples (2018), Kumoyo Island (2022), and the band wound down after a farewell tour.
5546899.name: Kikagaku Moyo

5552323.bio: Emma Ruth Rundle is a Los Angeles-born guitarist and singer-songwriter, formerly of Marriages, Red Sparowes and The Nocturnes. Her solo work blends slowcore, post-rock and dark folk. Albums include Marked for Death (2016), On Dark Horses (2018) and Engine of Hell (2021).
5552323.name: Emma Ruth Rundle

5569149.bio: Portuguese singer, composer and producer Débora Umbelino from Leiria, making songs in electronics, jazz and ambient experimentation. Her releases include the Sakamoto tribute EP if i'm not home : i'm not far away (2023), and she also sings in Bengali on newer releases.
5569149.name: Surma

55839.bio: Georgia band built around Andy Hull's emotive, biographical songs and textured post-hardcore-leaning rock. Records include Mean Everything to Nothing (2009), Cope (2014) and The Million Masks of God (2021).
55839.name: Manchester Orchestra

5605500.bio: Swiss band formed in 2014 by Melvyn Buss and Arci Friede, joined by sisters Jasmina and Nabyla Serag as vocalists, mixing electro, funk and pop with retro soul. Their debut SOL (2020) featured JID, followed by Peace (2023).
5605500.name: Sirens Of Lesbos

5646015.bio: Toronto indie pop band whose jangly, sugary melodies are shot through with melancholy and noise-rock fuzz, in the tradition of the C-86 sound. Their self-titled debut (2014) and Antisocialites (2017) built a devoted following, and Blue Rev (2022) sharpened the guitar crunch.
5646015.name: Alvvays

5652094.bio: Kehlani is an Oakland-born R&B singer who began as a dancer and singer and found fame through mixtapes. Key records include SweetSexySavage (2017), It Was Good Until It Wasn't (2020) and Blue Water Road (2022).
5652094.name: Kehlani

5657211.bio: Danish experimental pop band with formal training and a warm, curious sound. Debut Heba (2017) was followed by Hifalutin (2019), Keep Up the Good Work (2023) and Izithuthukuku (2025).
5657211.name: Lowly

5688806.bio: Duo of Harmony Tividad and Cleo Tucker, who started playing Los Angeles all-ages shows as high schoolers. They moved from minimal lo-fi punk-folk to fuller indie rock on records like Powerplant (2017) and What Chaos Is Imaginary (2019). Forgiveness (2022) followed.
5688806.name: Girlpool

56924.bio: Czechoslovak ambient and dream-pop group fronted by Irna Libowitz, with a large collective of sound designers and instrumentalists. Active in the 1990s, they were an ethereal, atmospheric act in the Slowdive and Bark Psychosis orbit.
56924.name: Ecstasy Of St. Theresa
56924.note: Tidal lists no albums; origin city assumed from Czechoslovak origin.

5726607.bio: Montreal DIY project formed by then-university students Dragos Chiriac and Jessy Caron, joined by vocalist Emmanuelle Proulx. They blend dreamy atmospheres, wistful chords and laid-back funky grooves; Oncle Jazz (2019), Untourable Album (2021) and Equus Caballus / Equus Asinus (2025) stand out.
5726607.name: Men I Trust

5730397.bio: Taiwanese math rock trio from Kaohsiung that puts bass guitar at the front of bright, rhythmic, instrumental-leaning songs. Influenced by Japanese acts like toe and tricot; albums include Underwater (2016) and World (2023).
5730397.name: Elephant Gym

5744956.bio: Instrumental guitar band from Plano, Texas, bridging progressive metal virtuosity and pop. Viral track Impassion (2013) led to Muse (2014), Renaissance (2016) and Remember That You Will Die (2022).
5744956.name: Polyphia

5750716.bio: Indie pop duo of producer Dan the Automator and actress-singer Mary Elizabeth Winstead. Their cinematic, retro-flavored debut I Love You But I Must Drive Off This Cliff Now arrived in 2014.
5750716.name: Got A Girl

5782729.bio: Parisian duo of twin sisters Lisa-Kaindé and Naomi Diaz, born in Cuba and raised mostly in France. They combine left-field pop and alternative R&B with Afro-Cuban roots music, singing in English, Spanish, French and Yoruba; albums include Ash (2017) and Spell 31 (2022).
5782729.name: Ibeyi

5806445.bio: Tom Misch is a London singer, guitarist and producer blending singer-songwriter soul, rare groove and 90s new jack swing. He rose with Geography (2018) and the collaboration What Kinda Music with Yussef Dayes (2020).
5806445.name: Tom Misch

5866385.bio: Oxnard, California rapper, singer, drummer and producer who first released music as Breeze Lovejoy before going solo in 2014. He blends funk, soul and hip hop with a smooth, rhythmic delivery. Records include Malibu (2016) and An Evening With Silk Sonic (2021) with Bruno Mars.
5866385.name: Anderson .Paak

5886040.bio: London dream pop and shoegaze duo of Nathalia Bruno and Jack Milwaukee (Iacopo Bertelli), formed in 2014. Their 2016 Nowhere EP pairs dreamy vocals with woozy guitars.
5886040.name: Leave the Planet

5893814.bio: Australian post-metal group from Sydney whose sound mixes sludgy guitars with cinematic post-rock crescendos. Formed in 2007; albums include Departure Songs (2015), Triumph & Disaster (2019) and A Single Flower (2025).
5893814.name: We Lost The Sea

5899631.bio: Leeds-based UK trio blending jazz, contemporary classical, electronica, folk and minimalism. They signed to ACT in 2025 and released Circadia in 2026, after earlier albums such as Gift from the Trees (2023).
5899631.name: Mammal Hands

5900081.bio: King Woman is Kristina Esfandiari's band, formed in California and blending drone, shoegaze and doom metal. After Created in the Image of Suffering (2017), they returned with Celestial Blues (2021), adding post-rock and grunge.
5900081.name: King Woman

5901047.bio: Amber Arcades is the project of Dutch songwriter Annelotte de Graaf, who works with different collaborators on each record. Fading Lines (2016) is dreamy indie pop made with Brooklyn players, European Heartbreak (2018) broadened the palette, and Barefoot on Diamond Road followed in 2023.
5901047.name: Amber Arcades

5903993.bio: Brisbane psychedelic rock band fronted by Aidan Moore. They released Mercy Mountain in 2015 and the concept album Dr Moses Love Hospital in 2022, with songs such as Shalala and Hole in the Wall.
5903993.name: Moses Gunn Collective

5927498.bio: Russian group (from Moscow) who describe their sound as stargaze, blending krautrock, shoegaze and techno with motorik rhythms and pulsing electronics. Albums include MU! (2019), Ax Ox (2023) and Losey (2026).
5927498.name: Gnoomes

5944151.bio: Cleveland duo formed in 2005 by Nicole Barille and Sam Meister, with melancholy, guitar-driven indie rock. Debut EP Echoes on the Ground was followed by albums such as The Heart of a Dark Star (2014) and The Day You Flew Away (2020).
5944151.name: Mr. Gnome

5950405.bio: Philadelphia rock band fronted by Marisa Dabice, mixing punk rock aggression, melodic indie and emotional intensity. Patience (2019) and I Got Heaven (2024) are among their records.
5950405.name: Mannequin Pussy

5978652.bio: Puerto Rican duo of Raquel Berrios and Luis Alfredo Del Valle, mixing indie dance-pop, electronic and funk with Caribbean rhythms. Their records include Regresa (2020) and Se Amaba Asi (2025).
5978652.name: Buscabulla

5978731.bio: Jordan Rakei is a New Zealand-born, Australian-raised, London-based singer, multi-instrumentalist and producer who makes soul-rooted alternative R&B. He debuted with the Franklin's Room EP (2013), signed to Ninja Tune for several albums, and released a live Royal Albert Hall record in 2025.
5978731.name: Jordan Rakei

6007100.bio: Japanese-American singer-songwriter known for velvety voice and dark, romantic indie rock. Albums include Bury Me at Makeout Creek (2014), Be the Cowboy (2018) and Laurel Hell (2022).
6007100.name: Mitski

6038062.bio: London rapper and actor with sharp, lyrical flow and theatrical production. Her releases include Grey Area (2019), Sometimes I Might Be Introvert (2021, Mercury Prize), No Thank You (2022), Drop 7 (2024) and Lotus (2025).
6038062.name: Little Simz

6113167.bio: American multi-instrumentalist and producer, founder and only constant member of The Brian Jonestown Massacre. His music mixes psychedelia, fuzzy garage rock, blues and space rock, and he also releases solo and collaborative work such as Parallel (2025).
6113167.name: Anton Newcombe

6158693.bio: Dutch quartet from Maastricht playing a cosmic, danceable fusion of funk, disco, psychedelia and Southeast Asian music. Albums include The Rabbit That Hunts Tigers (2019), The Age of Aquarius (2022), Mount Matsu (2024) and Yatta! (2026).
6158693.name: Yin Yin

61635851.bio: Supergroup-style project of Seattle multi-instrumentalist Daniel Lyon (Spirit Award) and Denver's Connor Birch (Flaural). Their self-titled debut (October 2025) combines psychedelic textures, krautrock pulse and electronic flourishes, with single Running Through the Airport.
61635851.name: Packaging

6171460.bio: Indie rock band led by Etta Friedman and Allegra Weingarten, formed in Berkeley and now based in New York. They mix heavy riffs, moody vocals and introspection on Welcome to My Blue Sky (2025).
6171460.name: MOMMA

6190473.bio: Brooklyn band rooted in Mumbai that merges Hindustani and Sufi music with psychedelia, shoegaze, ambient and Midwest emo. Releases include The Reverberating Sound of an Absent Metropolis (2024), Z of A (2025) and Darbar-e-Ishq (2026).
6190473.name: Minaxi

61938891.bio: Los Angeles band of childhood friends playing lush, fuzzy, discontented indie rock inspired by 90s alt rock. Debut EP Versions of You (2023) preceded R Is for Rocket (2025).
61938891.name: Rocket

6201863.bio: St Petersburg shoegaze band named after an Astrobrite album. Everything Else Matters (2015) and Grandfeathered (2016) mix dreamy guitars with electronic textures, followed by Miserable Miracles (2018).
6201863.name: Pinkshinyultrablast

6289811.bio: Los Angeles tenor saxophonist, composer and bandleader in the spiritual jazz tradition, and a member of the West Coast Get Down. The triple album The Epic (2015) made him a star; later work includes Heaven and Earth and Fearless Movement (2024).
6289811.name: Kamasi Washington

6309321.bio: Cafuné is a Brooklyn duo making percussive dream pop with electronic and shoegaze touches. They gained streaming traction after their 2015 EP Love Songs for Other People, and later released Love Songs for the End (2023) and Bite Reality (2025).
6309321.name: Cafuné

6367387.bio: Seattle-area band formed in Walla Walla, Washington around Julia Shapiro and Lydia Lund, with a deadpan, wry take on slacker guitar rock that has grown more dreamy over a decade. Key records include Time to Go Home (2015), Chastity Belt (2019) and Live Laugh Love (2024).
6367387.name: Chastity Belt

6388884.bio: All-female mariachi group from New York City, founded in 2008 and led by Mireya I. Ramos and Shae Fiol. They update traditional mariachi with fresh arrangements, notably on their 2014 self-titled debut.
6388884.name: Mariachi Flor De Toloache

6427480.bio: Estonian band blending shoegaze, country, R&B and psych-rock, fronted by Eliann Tulve's sleepy vocals. Early releases were indebted to Mazzy Star; later records include Slow Sundown (2018) and Horse (2020).
6427480.name: Holy Motors

6440088.bio: Fazerdaze is the project of New Zealand songwriter Amelia Murray. Her debut Morningside (2017) was daydreamy, echoey pop, followed by the fuzzier 90s-flavoured Break! EP (2022) and Soft Power (2024).
6440088.name: Fazerdaze

64518.bio: Oxfordshire band who moved from grunge-flavored rock to electronic and orchestral experimentation. The Bends (1995), OK Computer (1997) and Kid A (2000) are landmark albums.
64518.name: Radiohead

6456201.bio: Leon Bridges is a Fort Worth, Texas soul singer who went from dishwasher and busker to Grammy winner within two years. His retro-soul debut Coming Home (2015) was followed by Good Thing (2018), Gold-Diggers Sound (2021) and Leon (2024).
6456201.name: Leon Bridges

64638.bio: Singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist whose personal and spiritual music has made him a celebrated independent figure. Highlights include Illinois (2005), Carrie & Lowell (2015) and Javelin (2023).
64638.name: Sufjan Stevens

6503608.bio: Madrid garage-rock band that rose from the DIY scene with a raw, playful, lo-fi sound. Records include Leave Me Alone (2016), I Don't Run (2018), The Prettiest Curse (2020) and Viva Hinds (2024).
6503608.name: Hinds

65043.bio: Vincent Belorgey, French DJ and producer whose blend of French house, 8-bit video games and 1980s synth soundtracks helped shape synthwave. OutRun (2013) and Nightcall, famous from the film Drive, are key; Reborn arrived in 2022.
65043.name: Kavinsky

6511885.bio: Los Angeles psychedelic garage-punk band with a fuzzed-out, high-energy sound and a wide range of influences. Their records, including Zam (2019), Monsters Eating People Eating Monsters (2020) and Trash Classic (2025), are loud and trippy.
6511885.name: Frankie and the Witch Fingers

6537527.bio: The Littles appear to be a 1960s Iranian garage and psychedelic band, with tracks like Mehtaab and Fatemah Sultan on the Pebbles Vol. 11 Iran compilation. Tidal's single 2019 release, You've Got a Friend, suggests a reissue or catalog entry.
6537527.name: The Littles
6537527.note: Identification uncertain; may be a different act of the same name

6632454.bio: English artist Jed Stewart-Ng who started producing in his bedroom, making downtempo indie pop. Known for GOOD COMPANY (2020) and tracks like Lights Out.
6632454.name: Sonn

6632537.bio: Solo project of London-based singer-songwriter Amber Bain, fusing lush dream pop and brooding electronica. Albums include Good at Falling (2019) and In the End It Always Does (2023).
6632537.name: The Japanese House

66471.bio: Chapel Hill, North Carolina band, among the best-known math rock bands, with dissonant, intricately layered guitars and alternate tunings. Key records include Cor-Crane Secret (1992), Today's Active Lifestyles (1993), Exploded Drawing (1996) and In Prism (2009).
66471.name: Polvo

6671742.bio: German indie rock band mixing shoegaze with noisy space rock in sprawling songs. Their debut full-length Ringthing came in 2018, followed by Gold (2022) and 1984 (2024).
6671742.name: Jaguwar

6687095.bio: Independent Norwegian composer making instrumental, mostly piano-led relaxation music, released through the label Soothing Relaxation. Releases include O Holy Night (2020), Wonder (2023) and Peaceful Night (2023).
6687095.name: Peder B. Helland

6721143.bio: Italian psych-pop project led by producer Luca Bergomi, with singer Carlotta Menozzi, fusing 60s psychedelia with krautrock, disco and lo-fi pop. Records came via Bad Panda and later include Levitation Sessions (2023) and FIVE EGGS (2025).
6721143.name: Dumbo Gets Mad

6743691.bio: Los Angeles singer-songwriter with witty, devastating lyrics, delivering hook-filled indie pop and folk. Albums include Stranger in the Alps (2017) and Punisher (2020), and she is also part of boygenius.
6743691.name: Phoebe Bridgers

6828892.bio: Colombian-born singer, composer and multi-instrumentalist trained in classical music and percussion at the Tolima conservatory. His polished mix of Latin pop, funk and jazz spans the Sincopado EPs (2016, 2018), the album Memento (2020) and In Another Life (2024).
6828892.name: Jona Camacho

6831339.bio: Audri Nix is a young rapper and singer from San Juan, Puerto Rico, known for soft, sensual melodies and catchy lyrics. Tracks like Veneno and Complicado brought early attention from online outlets.
6831339.name: Audri Nix

6853694.bio: Brooklyn trio of Julia Cumming, Nick Kivlen and Jacob Faber, making dark psychedelic rock between The Velvet Underground and Fleetwood Mac. Albums include Human Ceremony (2016), Twentytwo in Blue (2018) and Mortal Primetime (2025).
6853694.name: Sunflower Bean

6891143.bio: London indie rock band led by Juliette Jackson, inspired by 90s grunge and Britpop. Debut Love in the 4th Dimension (2017) led to Walking Like We Do and Here Is Everything (2022).
6891143.name: The Big Moon

6938798.bio: Stockholm shoegaze and dream pop band formed in 2011 after Maja and Andreas met in Tokyo. Releases include You Said Forever (2019) and its deluxe edition.
6938798.name: Star Horse

6985510.bio: Copenhagen duo, centred on Australian songwriter Carl Coleman, operating between synth, rock and country with cinematic atmosphere. Albums include Waiting for the World to Turn (2016) and Nowadays (2018).
6985510.name: Palace Winter

7005513.bio: Maybe April is an Americana and country duo of Katy DuBois and Alaina Stacey, known for close harmonies and bittersweet, witty songs. Their albums are Maybe April (2017) and The Other Side (2019).
7005513.name: Maybe April

7027590.bio: Vitalism is a progressive metal and djent band from Rio de Janeiro, with technical grooves and lush guitar leads. Third EP Anima came out in May 2024, including the Pagan series.
7027590.name: Vitalism

7043333.bio: Post-punk band from Voronezh, Russia, singing in Russian, with brooding, atmospheric guitars. Releases include Pochva (2024) and Dobrolet Sessions (2026).
7043333.name: Ploho
7043333.note: Tidal bio missing; origin from general knowledge, not verified

7061089.bio: Atlanta rapper from the Spillage Village collective, signed to J. Cole's Dreamville. Known for fast-shifting flows and musically dense production. Albums include DiCaprio 2 (2018), The Forever Story (2022) and God Does Like Ugly (2025).
7061089.name: JID

7064771.bio: Brisbane shoegaze band formed in 2015, moving from reverb-soaked atmospherics on Auras (2017) to a heavier, noisier sound on Future of Illusion (2023), which added Kellie Lloyd of Screamfeeder on bass and vocals.
7064771.name: Deafcult

7092839.bio: Canadian-born vocalist and Crystal Castles co-founder who went solo after leaving the duo in 2014. Her music mixes abrasive electronics, industrial and whispered-to-screamed vocals. Key records are the self-titled debut (2018) and PREY//IV (2022).
7092839.name: Alice Glass

7097936.bio: New York rapper and singer Destiny Frasqueri, Afro-Puerto Rican, who started on YouTube and SoundCloud. Her playful, genre-bending records include 1992 Deluxe (2016) and Everything Is Beautiful (2018).
7097936.name: Princess Nokia

7154671.bio: Los Angeles-based singer-songwriter (born in Oregon) who rose from early industry buzz into a dreamy, noir-tinged psych-pop style. Her records include Belladonna of Sadness (2017), The Archer (2020) and Beneath the Lilypad (2025).
7154671.name: Alexandra Savior

7156172.bio: Chicago band, originally of Colombian heritage, making gentle psychedelia and dreamy indie pop. Foam (2019) and Last Spa on Earth (2022) are their main records.
7156172.name: Divino Niño

7188903.bio: Reading band playing arena-sized indie rock with big riffs and anthemic melodies. Early DIY success led to a major deal; albums include The Amazons (2017) and 21st Century Fiction (2025).
7188903.name: The Amazons

7202758.bio: TTNG, originally This Town Needs Guns, formed in Oxford in 2004. They play intricate, melodic math rock. Albums include Animals (2008) and 13.0.0.0.0 (2012).
7202758.name: TTNG

721.bio: Armenian-American band from Glendale, California, mixing thrash, folk melodies and political lyrics. Toxicity (2001) and Hypnotize (2005) are key albums; they have been largely on hiatus since the mid-2000s.
721.name: System Of A Down

7210489.bio: Experimental musician Sean Bowie who shifts from haunting ambient collage to hallucinogenic soul and dazzling rock. Safe in the Hands of Love (2018) and Heaven to a Tortured Mind (2020) show the range.
7210489.name: Yves Tumor

7222513.bio: London five-piece with an electro-post-punk sound, emerging with the single "Priestess". Albums are The Witch (2017) and Devastation (2019).
7222513.name: Pumarosa

7228945.bio: Manchester project of Ryan Kennedy, a Piccadilly Records employee, making melodic, dreamy guitar pop. The self-titled debut (2014) was recorded straight to tape. Later records include Beauty & Sadness (2017) and The Unforgiving Current (2019).
7228945.name: Horsebeach

7229721.bio: Dream pop band formed in Tokyo in 1993, releasing singles to strong underground reviews before their full-length After After Hours in 1997. They blend gentle shoegaze guitars with Stereolab-like pop. Later releases include headlights (2018).
7229721.name: Sugar Plant

7239329.bio: Liverpool five-piece making psychedelic pop with krautrock touches, nodding to Tame Impala and Echo and the Bunnymen. Debut album Course of the Satellite came out in 2018 on Deltasonic, recorded at Parr Street Studios.
7239329.name: The Vryll Society

7245028.bio: Math rock band from California whose twinkly, intricate guitar work is typical of the genre's emo-leaning side. They released a Floral EP (2014), The Second Floral EP (2015) and Floral LP (2020).
7245028.name: Floral
7245028.note: Based on short web sources; city unknown

7262284.bio: Chicago R&B singer making dreamy, atmospheric songs with honey-sweet vocals and psychedelic-tinged production. She emerged in the late 2010s with EPs, then Hypnos (2022) and Bird's Eye (2024). Blue Island is a 2026 release.
7262284.name: Ravyn Lenae

7280436.bio: Boston post-metal pioneers who treated heaviness through ambience, texture and long builds. Oceanic (2002) and Panopticon (2004) defined the genre before they split in 2010.
7280436.name: ISIS

7311651.bio: Jenny Lee Lindberg, bassist and vocalist of Warpaint, working solo as jennylee. Her debut Right on! (2014) was followed by Heart Tax (2022), moody, groove-driven art-pop.
7311651.name: jennylee

7319678.bio: Zambian-born, Botswana-raised rapper and poet based in Sydney whose music fuses hip hop, jazz, soul and African rhythms. The Return (2019) and As Above, So Below (2022) are key albums.
7319678.name: Sampa the Great

7337530.bio: Colombian-American singer, songwriter and producer whose left-field pop synthesises classic R&B, vocal jazz, salsa and contemporary Latin styles. Her debut Isolation (2018) was followed by Red Moon in Venus (2023) and Sincerely, (2025).
7337530.name: Kali Uchis

7389804.bio: Chencho Corleone is a Puerto Rican reggaeton artist, one half of the duo Plan B alongside Maldy. He became a genre figurehead in the 2000s with a distinctive nasal delivery, and returned to prominence with the 2022 hit "Me Porto Bonito" with Bad Bunny and his 2024 solo album.
7389804.name: Chencho Corleone

7401022.bio: One-man instrumental project of Melbourne's Rohan Stevenson, making cinematic, cloud-like progressive post-rock and ambient metal, self-releasing since 2012. Albums include The Zenith Rise (2019), The Quiet Place Away (2022) and Promise Me You'll Thrive (2026).
7401022.name: I Built the Sky

7432292.bio: Multidisciplinary British-American artist (formerly Antony Hegarty of Antony and the Johnsons) whose soulful voice anchors work spanning chamber ballads, electronica and protest art. I Am a Bird Now won the 2005 Mercury Prize, and HOPELESSNESS (2016) and My Back Was a Bridge for You to Cross (2023) pushed into electronic and soul territory.
7432292.name: ANOHNI

7441810.bio: Soft Lashes is the project of singer-songwriter Natalia Yanchak (Tali), who was active in London. Her dark, ethereal synth pop includes Hypersensuality (2017), after earlier albums like Beloved Stranger.
7441810.name: Soft Lashes

7471790.bio: Phoenix, Arizona band merging post-metal heaviness, shoegaze and dreamy electronics into widescreen, emotional soundscapes. Albums include Death Spells (2018) and Dimensional Bleed (2022).
7471790.name: Holy Fawn

7479676.bio: Rapper, singer and visual artist Ingrid Burley from Houston's Third Ward, granddaughter of a local jazz musician. Known for the Trill Feels EP (2016).
7479676.name: Ingrid

7482415.bio: Nottingham indie band named after a Slowdive song, often labelled shoegaze with bigger choruses. They signed to Saint Marie Records and released the EP Immersed Within Your Eyes in 2017.
7482415.name: When The Sun Hits

7506198.bio: Baltimore indie rock project of singer-guitarist Lindsey Jordan. Lush (2018) was lo-fi and candid; Valentine (2021) added polish and synths, with Ricochet in 2026.
7506198.name: Snail Mail

7514330.bio: Los Angeles singer-songwriter who debuted as a young teen with moody, whispery electro-pop made with her brother Finneas. Her breakthrough was When We All Fall Asleep, Where Do We Go? (2019), followed by Happier Than Ever (2021) and Hit Me Hard and Soft (2024). She is a major pop star with multiple Grammys.
7514330.name: Billie Eilish

7534938.bio: Instrumental post-rock band formed in 2014 with members spread across Germany and Belgium. They mix post-metal heaviness with ambient and sprawling, atmospheric guitar passages. Releases are Sukzession (2015) and Firn (2018).
7534938.name: Cataya

7540050.bio: Montreal duo mixing dream pop, shoegaze and trip-hop with an experimental streak. Debut Comforter (2019) was followed by I Held the Shape While I Could (2023).
7540050.name: Bodywash

7544068.bio: Austin, Texas duo Charlie Martin and Will Taylor making intimate, lo-fi-influenced indie rock with echoes of slowcore bands like Duster. Releases include Taster (2016), Cranberry (2018) and Big World (2026).
7544068.name: Hovvdy

75507723.bio: Psychedelic-rock project of vocalist and producer Jameson Hrilovic, listed as based in Germany. Releases include the 2026 album ROOM 203: BROKEN IN THE GLASS.
75507723.name: Heavy Psychadelics
75507723.note: Little information found; origin per a single aggregator source (Germany) and uncertain

7558987.bio: Jay Som is the project of Melina Duterte, a Bay Area musician who records most instruments herself. Her bedroom-made indie rock and dream pop is heard on Everybody Works (2017), Anak Ko (2019) and Belong (2025).
7558987.name: Jay Som

7563521.bio: Canadian rock duo from Kingston, Ontario with gritty riffs, nervy drums and hook-heavy choruses. They broke through with the album Bummer (2021) and have since released Fake Moon and Scrap (both 2025).
7563521.name: Cleopatrick

7567313.bio: Amsterdam group that began as Pip Blom's bedroom solo project and grew into a quartet of 90s lo-fi indie rock. Records include Boat (2019), Welcome Break and Bobbie (2023).
7567313.name: Pip Blom

7583051.bio: Florida-based music producer and composer best known for the soundtracks to the educational YouTube channel Koranos, released as Koranos Vol. 1 (2023) and Vol. 2 (2024). He also released the instrumental album Music For Washing Dishes (2021).
7583051.name: Joseph McDade

7589458.bio: Controversial rapper Jahseh Onfroy who played loose with genre, mixing punk rock, hip hop, R&B and heavy metal in the late 2010s. 17 (2018) and ? (2018) were his main records; he was killed in 2018 and posthumous releases continue.
7589458.name: XXXTENTACION

7598676.bio: English rock band from Brighton fronted by Theresa Jarvis, combining heavy riffs, hooks and punk fury. After the EP Heavy they released Don't Wait 'Til Tomorrow (2019), then Welcome to My House (2023) and Until You're Satisfied (2026).
7598676.name: YONAKA

7626557.bio: Project of Australian songwriter Angus Stone (also half of Angus & Julia Stone), offering laid-back, hazy indie pop with a slacker groove. Albums include Honey Bones (2019), Smooth Big Cat and Kimosabe (2023).
7626557.name: Dope Lemon

7643091.bio: Chicago band formed by Julien Ehrlich and Max Kakacek, both ex-Smith Westerns, making warm indie pop/rock with folk, country and electronic touches. Albums include Light Upon the Lake (2016), Candid (2020) and Small Talk (2025).
7643091.name: Whitney

7644395.bio: English singer-songwriter from Walsall mixing hip-hop soul, garage and alt-pop, rising in the late 2010s. Albums include Lost & Found (2018), Falling or Flying (2023) and What Are The Odds (2026).
7644395.name: Jorja Smith

7679202.bio: Norwegian indie punk band from Stavanger, with punchy, danceable songs about 80s idols and relatable romance, citing the Pixies and Fiona Apple. Albums include Try Not to Freak Out (2017), the slumber tapes (2020) and Film Buff (2024).
7679202.name: Sløtface

7703355.bio: Chilean DJ and performer from Santiago known for raunchy reggaeton and perreo. Releases include Bien y Mal (2016), Bellaca del Ano (2018) and TDR (2019).
7703355.name: Tomasa del Real
7703355.note: No Tidal bio; from background knowledge and hints

7707422.bio: Melbourne-born, London-based singer and multi-instrumentalist who writes haunting, minimal songs drawing on post-punk, dub and ambient pop. Earlier in Mole House and F ingers, she is known solo for You Know What It's Like (2016) and Come Around (2022).
7707422.name: Carla dal Forno

7733969.bio: Little-known act on Tidal whose releases include the tracks Elm and Ohmygodiloveyoupleasedontleaveme (2018, Barely Regal Records). Web results point to a UK band, possibly from Sheffield, but the match is uncertain.
7733969.name: Clever Girl
7733969.note: Identity uncertain; sources mix Sheffield prog/art rock tag with emo playlists

7737006.bio: Houston band mixing shoegaze with 90s alternative rock and heavier guitar. Moments of Clarity (2023) is their breakthrough on Run for Cover.
7737006.name: Narrow Head
7737006.note: No Tidal bio; identified from own knowledge and album hints

7768587.bio: VHS Dream is a Melbourne duo of Matthew Hosking and Mayzie Cocco Wallen making dreamy guitar-pop. Their album Departure (2016) came out on Husky Recordings.
7768587.name: VHS Dream

7771919.bio: Calgary post-punk band that began as Viet Cong, renamed Preoccupations. Their rough, existential post-punk touches psych-pop, shoegaze and noise. Albums include Viet Cong (2015), Preoccupations (2016), and Ill at Ease (2025).
7771919.name: Preoccupations

7773162.bio: English singer-songwriter from Bristol area who delivers melancholic songs in a hushed tone, in the lineage of Joni Mitchell and Laura Marling. Records include On Hold (2018), BREACH (2020) and Big Picture (2023). Win Win is a 2026 release.
7773162.name: Fenne Lily

778.bio: Goat are an experimental psychedelic rock band from Korpilombolo, Sweden, associated with Gothenburg, masked and shrouded in myth. They draw on Afrobeat, Anatolian funk and heavy rock. World Music (2012) and Commune (2014) are key records.
778.name: Goat

7782790.bio: London group making experimental electronic pop drawing on Sun Ra, Alice Coltrane and Stereolab. Albums include Choose Your Own Adventure (2016), Afternoon X (2023) and Archives (2026).
7782790.name: Vanishing Twin

7890474.bio: Los Angeles duo Mica Tenenbaum and Matthew Lewin making quirky, left-field synth-pop with early-2000s production gloss. Debut Mercurial World (2021) led to the acclaimed Imaginal Disk (2024).
7890474.name: Magdalena Bay

7899267.bio: Hard rock quartet from Frankenmuth, Michigan, formed by the three Kiszka brothers and drummer Danny Wagner, with a sound that draws heavily on 70s Led Zeppelin. Albums include Anthem of the Peaceful Army (2018) and Starcatcher (2023).
7899267.name: Greta Van Fleet

7945551.bio: Perth psychedelic band fronted by Nick Allbrook, with Jay Watson among early members, started as a Royal Trux-meets-Cream trio. Records include Hobo Rocket (2013), The Weather (2017) and Stung! (2024).
7945551.name: Pond

7945731.bio: Floridian singer-songwriter of Cuban descent making sensual R&B ballads. She gained streams with Belong to You and Unravel Me from the mixtape About Time (2017) and later released Archives & Lullabies (2023) and Fall in Love with Her (2025).
7945731.name: Sabrina Claudio

7950138.bio: Hopes & Venom were a post-rock duo from St. Gallen, Switzerland, of drummer Jorin Engel and guitarist-singer Skiba Shapiro. They released the Alpha | Omega EP (2016) and Gifts (2017), mixing shoegaze, alt-metal and experimental textures.
7950138.name: Hopes & Venom

7995155.bio: Spanish rapper, singer and songwriter Antón Álvarez Alfaro from Madrid, who began in hip hop and became a pop-urban star. El Madrileño (2021) mixed flamenco, rumba, bolero and pop with big Spanish and Latin collaborators, and followed his Avida Dollars (2018).
7995155.name: C. Tangana

8017549.bio: Stage name of Sophie Allison, a singer-songwriter born in Nashville who channels 1990s indie rock with conversational, confessional lyrics. She started with self-released bedroom recordings, then made Clean (2018), Color Theory (2020), Sometimes, Forever (2022) and Evergreen (2024).
8017549.name: Soccer Mommy

8027279.bio: Puerto Rican superstar and one of the biggest Spanish-language artists in the world, mixing reggaeton, Latin trap and Caribbean styles. Key records include Un Verano Sin Ti (2022), nadie sabe lo que va a pasar mañana (2023) and DeBI TiRAR MaS FOToS (2025).
8027279.name: Bad Bunny

8028874.bio: Folk and indie singer-songwriter from Julian, California who self-releases on Bandcamp. His catalogue includes Northern Lights (remastered 2015), It Won't Feel the Same Tomorrow and the demo collection Cosmic Address (2019).
8028874.name: Dominic Bennett
8028874.note: No Tidal bio; sparse web sources.

8035907.bio: Oliver Tree is a Los Angeles singer, producer and comedian with a satirical persona. He mixes indie pop, hip hop and dance. Key records include Ugly Is Beautiful (2020) and Alone in a Crowd (2022).
8035907.name: Oliver Tree

8036923.bio: Swedish post-rock trio from Malmo whose sound moves between dark and brighter passages, driven by synths as much as guitars. Releases include Penumbra (2020) and Corpse Lights (2025) on Pelagic Records.
8036923.name: BARRENS

8054795.bio: Low Hum is the psychedelic synth pop project of Collin Deshazer from Los Angeles. His music balances clubby beats, textured noise and billowy atmospheres. Albums include Room to Breathe (2019), Nonfiction (2021) and Terra Incognita (2024).
8054795.name: Low Hum

8057831.bio: Chicago trio making reverb-soaked, stripped-back indie pop with minimal drums and shared vocals. Releases include Water (2020), Blue Skies (2022) and Poetry (2024).
8057831.name: Dehd

8112.bio: Chic were the definitive disco band, led by guitarist Nile Rodgers and bassist Bernard Edwards, formed in New York in 1976. Their sleek, groove-driven records such as Good Times and Le Freak became disco and hip hop touchstones. They continued touring in the 2020s as Nile Rodgers and Chic.
8112.name: CHIC

8127718.bio: Trap artist born Zoe Canto in Paris in 1993 and based in Madrid, steeped in flamenco traditions. Started with La Vendicion Records. Albums include La Reina del Sur (2023) and PUSSY TASTE (2024).
8127718.name: La Zowi

8140560.bio: Marylou Mayniel, French singer, producer and DJ, writing dreamy futuristic pop influenced by ambient, trance and left-field R&B. After the mixtape Galore (2020) came choke enough (2025).
8140560.name: Oklou

8150823.bio: Swiss-Italian singer-songwriter, known for sharp songwriting, soulful energy and a genre-fluid sound. Releases include All the Colors of the Sky (2023).
8150823.name: Veronica Fusaro

8161298.bio: American pop-rock singer-songwriter who broke out in 2021 with Driver's License. Albums include Sour (2021), Guts (2023) and you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love (2026).
8161298.name: Olivia Rodrigo

8164081.bio: Mercurial London singer-songwriter crossing indie rock, jazz, psychedelia and electronics. She rose with EPs and singles like Small Crimes before debut Miss Universe (2019), then PAINLESS (2022) and My Method Actor (2024).
8164081.name: Nilüfer Yanya

8191121.bio: Alias of British musician George van den Broek from Southampton, known for throaty vocals and swimmy indie soul-pop. He broke out as a teenager; albums include A Day in a Yellow Beat (2018), Emotional Education (2021) and Rock and a Hard Place (2026).
8191121.name: Yellow Days

8214323.bio: Skinny Pelembe is a Sheffield-based musician, signed to Gilles Peterson's Brownswood, known for a mix of jazz, soul and psychedelic hip hop. Dreaming Is Dead Now (2019) and Hardly the Same Snake (2023) are key records.
8214323.name: Skinny Pelembe

8240439.bio: English-American actress and singer making lovelorn, reverb-heavy retro pop with weary vocals. Records include I Can't Let Go (2022), Memoir of a Sparklemuffin (2024) and Loveland (2026).
8240439.name: Suki Waterhouse

8260554.bio: Brooklyn band making intense, abrasive yet playful noise and dance-punk. Albums include Dogsbody (2023) and Pirouette (2025).
8260554.name: Model/Actriz
