8266580.bio: Dream pop band led by Greg Gonzalez, formed in El Paso, Texas and later based in Brooklyn. Hushed vocals and reverb-soaked guitars define their slow, romantic sound. Known for Cigarettes After Sex (2017) and Cry (2019).
8266580.name: Cigarettes After Sex

8268038.bio: Spanish-Catalan artist Alba Farelo, who went viral in 2016 with a dancehall cover of Rihanna's Work. She blends reggaeton, trap and dancehall in songs about youth and sexuality. Releases include Slow Wine mixtape, Warm Up and La Joia (2023).
8268038.name: Bad Gyal

8268696.bio: Guitarist and composer from San Jose, member of math rock band Covet, also known as a solo artist and for her tapping style.
8268696.name: Yvette Young
8268696.note: No Tidal bio or hints; based on own knowledge, not web-verified

8273084.bio: American singer-songwriter who won America's Got Talent in 2016 as a teenager with her ukulele and original songs. Her work has moved from ukulele pop toward moodier indie pop, including CHILDSTAR (2025).
8273084.name: Grace VanderWaal
8273084.note: Bio from general knowledge and hints; no Tidal bio

8283423.bio: Holygram is a Cologne, Germany band formed in 2015, blending post-punk, new wave, krautrock and shoegaze. Their debut album Modern Cults came out in 2018 on Cleopatra Records, produced with Maurizio Baggio.
8283423.name: Holygram

8306846.bio: Iranian-Israeli actress and singer Liraz Charhi, based in Tel Aviv and Los Angeles. She merges Persian and Israeli music in atmospheric electropop, Persian disco and neo-psychedelia, with the albums Naz (2018), Zan (2020) and Roya (2022).
8306846.name: Liraz

8376.bio: Portland psych-pop band with cheeky detachment, mixing psych rock, shoegaze, power pop and synth-pop. Hits include Not If You Were the Last Junkie on Earth and Bohemian Like You; later albums include Rockmaker (2024).
8376.name: The Dandy Warhols

8416599.bio: Peruvian singer and rapper from Ayacucho, born in 2001, who went viral in 2015 with a Quechua cover of Michael Jackson. She performs trap and rap largely in Quechua; debut album Isqun (2021) honors five Peruvian women.
8416599.name: Renata Flores

8421125.bio: Moscow post-punk trio of Arvid Kriger, Tonia Minaeva and Ramil Mubinov, working in post-punk revival and new wave modes. Releases include Two Rooms (2023) and Common Feeling (2025).
8421125.name: Human Tetris

8434703.bio: Dounia is an American singer, songwriter and model who grew up building a social media following. Since the Intro To EP (2017) she has refined an understated mix of R&B and hip hop across EPs and albums such as Mrs. Lovebomb (2025).
8434703.name: Dounia

8489040.bio: Los Angeles dream-pop and slowcore duo of Wyatt Ininns and Victor Pakpour, DIY since their 2015 debut Hurt. Eleven albums in, they released Paper Halo in 2026 and are touring Mexico and Europe.
8489040.name: Ruby Haunt

8511643.bio: Shoegaze and dream-pop band formed in Barnaul, Siberia in 2015 by Yana Guselnikova and Daniil Levshin, later based in Saint Petersburg and then scattered across Europe after 2022. Their records include Everything (2021) and Decisions (2025, Automatic Music).
8511643.name: Blankenberge

8517573.bio: Atlanta singer-songwriter who started writing country-tinged songs as a teenager and came up via a rap collective. Her gentle, deadpan style spans indie folk, soul and pedal steel, on records such as Atlanta Millionaires Club (2019), I Know I'm Funny haha (2021) and Underdressed at the Symphony (2024).
8517573.name: Faye Webster

8523033.bio: Swiss pop musician Alexander Frei, whose warm voice and synth-heavy sound draws on 1980s pop and dark wave, with a melancholy edge. Leave Me Baby (2018) hit number 2 in Switzerland and earned him the 2018 Swiss Music Award for Best Talent, and Fake Nails (2021) followed.
8523033.name: CRIMER
8523033.note: City not verified; Tidal bio used partially

8538031.bio: Girl Ultra is the project of Nan de Miguel from Mexico City, blending 90s R&B influences with contemporary Latin pop. Albums include Nuevos Aires (2019) and El Sur (2022).
8538031.name: Girl Ultra

8595878.bio: Alex Giannascoli is a singer-songwriter and producer from Philadelphia making lo-fi, melodic and often experimental pop-rock. He moved from Bandcamp releases to Domino with records like House of Sugar and God Save the Animals (2022), and has scored films including We're All Going to the World's Fair.
8595878.name: Alex G

8603466.bio: Biig Piig is Jessica Smyth, an Irish-born, London-based singer and songwriter making whispery, laid-back R&B with jazz, rap and pop touches. She moved from open-mic ukulele sets to RCA, releasing The Sky Is Bleeding (2021), Bubblegum (2023) and 11:11 (2025).
8603466.name: Biig Piig

8603701.bio: Chinese shoegaze and dream pop band formed in north Beijing in 2016 (English name Default). Their debut EP California Nebula (2017) led to a deal with SJ-Records, and 共同的土地 (2023) followed.
8603701.name: 缺省

8670119.bio: Little-known act on Tidal whose releases include Spring Fever (2024), with tracks such as Wilderness and Two Souls. Could not be identified from available sources.
8670119.name: The Bear's Cave
8670119.note: Could not identify artist; bio based on hints only

8685627.bio: American singer-songwriter who started as a bedroom pop artist and developed a soft-rock, 70s-tinged sound with R&B touches. Key records are Immunity (2019), Sling (2021) and Charm (2024).
8685627.name: Clairo

8725355.bio: London singer-songwriter Jacob Allen, known for languid atmospheric songs blending indie rock, alternative R&B, downtempo and trip hop. Records include In Praise of Shadows (2021) and antichamber (2025).
8725355.name: Puma Blue

8750158.bio: Australian dream pop artist Harriette Pilbeam, from Brisbane. Her 1990s-inspired shoegaze guitars and soaring choruses recall Cocteau Twins. Records include Keepsake (2019), Giving the World Away (2022) and Liquorice (2025).
8750158.name: Hatchie

8757140.bio: London saxophonist, composer and bandleader and a leading figure of the UK jazz and club scene. Collaborated with Makaya McCraven and Moses Boyd; her records are Source (2020) and Odyssey (2024).
8757140.name: Nubya Garcia

8792178.bio: Dutch-Turkish band reviving and modernizing Turkish psychedelic folk from the late 1960s and 70s. They pair traditional songs and saz with fuzz guitars and synths, as heard on On (2018), Gece (2019) and Yol (2021).
8792178.name: Altin Gün

8808669.bio: Korean-Canadian singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist who makes sweetly psychedelic indie pop and compact beat-driven instrumentals. Her debut album Jams for Jamie came in 2021, followed by When a Thought Grows Wings (2024).
8808669.name: Luna Li

8821167.bio: Los Angeles indie pop band led by Puerto Rican-born singer Maria Zardoya and drummer-producer Josh Conway, with a smooth bilingual mix of psych, jazz, Latin and lounge. Cinema (2021), Submarine (2024).
8821167.name: The Marías

8839251.bio: Argentine rapper and singer from Cordoba who became a star before 20 with the 2017 hit Relax. His urban Latin sound blends trap, reggaeton and pop; albums include Homerun and Versus (2025).
8839251.name: Paulo Londra

8853.bio: Virtual band created in 1998 by Damon Albarn and artist Jamie Hewlett, a cartoon group with a rotating cast of collaborators. They mix hip hop, pop, dub and electronics; Feel Good Inc. and Demon Days (2005) are highlights. The Mountain is a 2026 record.
8853.name: Gorillaz

8883.bio: San Francisco rock trio that emerged during the early-2000s garage revival with a noisier, more psychedelic edge. Their sound draws on Jesus and Mary Chain fuzz and blues. Key records: B.R.M.C. (2001) and Howl (2005).
8883.name: Black Rebel Motorcycle Club

8904809.bio: Pink Skies is Arieh, an Oakland, California musician who played in the Bay Area indie and punk scenes. His project makes indie rock and pop, with albums The Tree That Broke the Cement (2023) and American Mood Ring (2025).
8904809.name: Pink Skies

8914.bio: Long Beach rapper who became a face of 90s gangsta rap after Dr. Dre's The Chronic. Albums include Doggystyle (1993), Tha Doggfather (1996) and Tha Last Meal (2000).
8914.name: Snoop Dogg

8979008.bio: English folk-pop singer-songwriter from Sussex who built a following on YouTube before charting with witty, confessional songs. Albums include You Signed Up for This (2021) and The Good Witch (2023).
8979008.name: Maisie Peters

8986224.bio: Noname is a Chicago rapper and poet, known for observant, conversational verses and jazzy production. Key records include the mixtape Telefone (2016), Room 25 (2018) and Sundial (2023).
8986224.name: Noname

8990.bio: Reykjavik post-rock band famous for Jonsi's falsetto, bowed guitar and cosmic atmospheres. Agaetis Byrjun (1999), () and Takk made them international stars; ATTA (2023) followed a long break.
8990.name: Sigur Rós

9012605.bio: Hull quartet moving between dream pop and shoegaze, alternating ethereal melancholy with driving, delay-soaked guitars. Debut Bedroom (2020) added post-punk and krautrock touches, followed by I Don't Know (2023) and Microtonic (2025).
9012605.name: Bdrmm

9028244.bio: London neo-soul singer-songwriter delivering smooth, confessional R&B. Debuted with "Make Me Cry" in 2018 and released When Everything Is Better, I'll Let You Know (2022) and Tell Jimmy I'm fine (2024).
9028244.name: Pip Millett

9045.bio: Moby is an American producer, DJ and singer-songwriter from New York, a major figure in electronic music who also works in rock and pop. His breakthrough was Play (1999), with "Porcelain", after early rave hits in the early 90s.
9045.name: Moby

9056.bio: Bristol collective regarded as originators of trip hop, with a dark, cinematic mix of hip hop beats, soulful voices and dub. Blue Lines (1991), Protection (1994) and Mezzanine (1998) are landmarks. Heligoland (2010) is their latest full album in this list.
9056.name: Massive Attack

9072819.bio: Shoegaze and dream pop duo of Anna Wagner and Lucas Inacio, founded in Ilhabela, Brazil and now based in Vancouver. Their sound blends fuzzy guitars, trip-hop and soothing vocals on Tangy Dream (2017) and Rêve Bleu (2020).
9072819.name: Palm Haze

9097202.bio: Dundalk quintet fronted by Katie Ball, fusing post-rock, shoegaze and dream pop into a brooding, discordant sound. Albums include Heart Under (2022) and We Were Just Here (2025).
9097202.name: Just Mustard

9101.bio: French duo Nicolas Godin and Jean-Benoit Dunckel, who blend vintage synths, pop craft and lounge-tinged electronica. Their 1998 debut Moon Safari/Blue Moon Safari-era sound made them standard-bearers of French touch, and they also scored The Virgin Suicides (2000).
9101.name: Air

9132216.bio: London-based instrumental band blending surf rock, cumbia, Turkish psychedelia and disco. Active since 2019, they have released Let the Festivities Begin! (2022) and Talkie Talkie (2024).
9132216.name: Los Bitchos

9147884.bio: San Francisco singer, songwriter and producer born in Paris to a French mother and Algerian father. She blends R&B, hip hop and pop with a dreamy edge. Records include High Highs to Low Lows (2019), PLAYGIRL (2022) and Reverie (2026).
9147884.name: Lolo Zouaï

9149809.bio: Argentine-Spanish singer-songwriter born in Buenos Aires and based in Madrid, who moved from the underground to Latin Grammy fame. Blends salsa, rap, jazz and pop; albums include Calambre (2020), GRATA SORPRESA (2024) and MALPORTADA (2025).
9149809.name: Nathy Peluso

9160820.bio: London singer-songwriter and poet whose vividly detailed lyrics deal with young adult emotion and mental health. Her sound mixes bedroom pop with indie soul, and debut Collapsed in Sunbeams (2021) won the Mercury Prize, followed by My Soft Machine (2023) and Ambiguous Desire (2026).
9160820.name: Arlo Parks

9231923.bio: Mexican/Salvadoran-American artist who began as an alt-rock and country songwriter before moving into her own alt-pop persona. Her breakthrough EP came in 2025; earlier work includes Wish You Were Here (2021).
9231923.name: Niko Rubio

9245.bio: New York indie rock band that led the early-2000s revival with the Strokes and Yeah Yeah Yeahs. Their dark, post-punk-inflected sound defined Turn On the Bright Lights (2002) and Antics (2004). This Mirror Weighs a Ton is a 2026 record.
9245.name: Interpol

9249274.bio: Mexican singer, songwriter and multi-instrumentalist from Veracruz, mixing North and Latin American traditions with son jarocho roots. Known for Marchita (2022) and Vendran Suaves Lluvias (2025).
9249274.name: Silvana Estrada

9329127.bio: Atlanta R&B singer-songwriter known for self-recorded ballads and slow jams. Over It (2019) hit number two on the Billboard 200 and was followed by Still Over It (2021) and Finally Over It (2025).
9329127.name: Summer Walker

9350878.bio: Junodream is a London four-piece formed in 2018 who call their sound space rock. Their dreamy guitar melodies and heavy atmosphere feature on the debut album Pools of Colour (2024) on AWAL.
9350878.name: Junodream

9484963.bio: Dublin five-piece with abrasive, poetic post-punk and a strong sense of place. Debut Dogrel (2019) was followed by A Hero's Death, Skinty Fia (2022) and the more melodic Romance (2024).
9484963.name: Fontaines D.C.

9538900.bio: Bratty is a Mexican singer-songwriter who moved from alt-rock toward a more polished pop sound with songs like "Honey, No Estas" (2019). Her 2026 album HOSHI marks a new pop-oriented phase.
9538900.name: Bratty

9541540.bio: Tidal entry for the music publication Pitchfork, not a musical act. Tidal's text just describes it as a trusted music voice.
9541540.name: Pitchfork
9541540.note: Not an artist: Pitchfork is a music publication; no albums or tracks in hints.

9573221.bio: Australian rapper and singer Zheani, from Melbourne, known for a dark, confrontational style spanning rap, metal and horror-tinged themes. Albums: I Hate People on the Internet (2022), The Spiritual Meat Grinder (2023), LONG LIVE THE OLD DEAD GODS (2025).
9573221.name: Zheani
9573221.note: Tidal bio is missing and no web verification; based on prior knowledge and hint titles.

9622608.bio: TT is the solo project of Theresa Wayman, singer and guitarist of Los Angeles band Warpaint. Her tracks include Love Leaks and The Dream; Tidal lists no albums.
9622608.name: TT

9650.bio: Jason Martin's California project, emerging in 1993 with shoegaze-leaning sound that later moved through Beatlesque pop and dreamy space rock. Records include Silver (1994) and later Lust for Gold (2024).
9650.name: Starflyer 59

9691016.bio: Canadian trio from Peterborough, Ontario, later based in Montreal, playing scrappy, catchy indie punk and garage rock. Their album The Pits (2018) came out on Buzz Records and deals with the end of their small-town social circle.
9691016.name: Lonely Parade

9706.bio: One of rock's defining bands, London's Pink Floyd created an elastic, echoing, spacey sound exploring ego, memory and alienation. Landmark albums include The Dark Side of the Moon (1973), Wish You Were Here (1975) and The Wall (1979).
9706.name: Pink Floyd

9723517.bio: Detroit-born producer, DJ and sound artist and cofounder of label Hume, alternating between club textures and soft sculptural soundscapes. Records include Suggested Forms (2020) and a pool, a portal (2024).
9723517.name: Tristan Arp

9751628.bio: Argentine singer-songwriter and experimental musician working with healing songs and world music. Releases include the album Canciones del Corazon (2020) and the track Sagrado Femenino.
9751628.name: Loli Cosmica
9751628.note: Little-known act; details from search snippets only

9770131.bio: Canadian ensemble combining Japanese eleki guitar rock with Western pop and psychedelia. Known for Shirushi (2021) and Hagata (2023), also contributed to the Assassin's Creed Shadows soundtrack (2025).
9770131.name: TEKE::TEKE

9788448.bio: Classically trained singer-songwriter, multi-instrumentalist and producer from Los Angeles whose shape-shifting pop draws on encyclopedic knowledge of the genre. He debuted at 19 with Jules (2019) and followed with The Sale (2022).
9788448.name: Julien Chang

9808413.bio: South London singer Aria Wells, from Bermondsey, whose hazy, spiritual 'sunny hip hop' mixes neo-soul, dub, reggae and psychedelia. Debut Man Made (2021) was followed by GREENZONE 108 (2022) and Tell Dem It's Sunny (2025).
9808413.name: Greentea Peng

9812034.bio: Montreal musician from Saguenay, Quebec, releasing since 2018 under the banner of new synth folk, with pop, sitar, dance and R&B touches. Albums include Voyage to Mars (2022) and Jardin (2023).
9812034.name: MUNYA

9835680.bio: Swiss-Ecuadorian brothers Alejandro and Estevan Gutierrez, who make instrumental music with acoustic guitars, lap steel and percussion, evoking desert landscapes and spaghetti-western cinema. Records include El Bueno y El Malo (2022) and Los Ojos del Condor (2026).
9835680.name: Hermanos Gutiérrez

9912.bio: Danish post-grunge guitar band featuring Sune Rose Wagner, who later co-founded The Raveonettes. Their short run around 2001 produced albums like Hi-Fi Low Life and The Quiet Album.
9912.name: Psyched Up Janis

9985670.bio: South London jazz drummer and composer, early in the UK jazz scene via United Vibrations and Yussef Kamaal. Solo albums include Black Classical Music (2023).
9985670.name: Yussef Dayes
